common_tasks: Explain authorised findings with provenance labels
Propose scan plans within exact target grants
Triage findings and draft remediation proposals
Map controls and draft executive reports
Queue AI work when the sidecar or model is degraded
disclaimers: Petraclus remains the source of truth for targets, authorisation evidence, finding truth, workflows, licences and UI.
Keprix provides grounded explanation, proposed prioritisation, playbooks and policy-gated tools only.
Licence authority remains product-side and keys.petraclus.uk; Keprix never mints or unlocks licences.
limitations: Exploit automation is off. No shell, arbitrary HTTP, free-form nmap, exploit-run, credential-read, unrestricted file-read or remediation-execute nodes.
Active scan, credentialed scan and mutate actions require exact target grant, approval and edition entitlement, revalidated before each action.
Live product API must be wired for production; local fixture is for contract tests only.
can_do: Register read, analysis, proposal and gated action capability nodes
Enforce product, workspace, edition, role, target grant and purpose isolation
Run air-gapped provision plans without phone-home
cannot_do: Create target authorisation or extend licence grace
Run exploits or apply production remediation
Silently change scanner severity or verified state
